name: golden-hour-wellness-colorado
description: Static site for Golden Hour Wellness Colorado, LLC. Pages are generated by the Python scripts in the repo root; TinaCMS edits the JSON in /content.

scripts.pages: python3 build_pages.py && python3 build_content.py && python3 build_services.py && python3 build_legal.py && python3 build_blog.py && python3 apply_content.py
scripts.build: python3 scripts/check_redirects.py && npm run pages && tinacms build && bash scripts/collect.sh
scripts.dev: npm run pages && tinacms dev -c "python3 -m http.server 8080"
